#@path: src/core/ball_movement/ball_core.gd
extends RefCounted

var a: Node3D
var b: CharacterBody3D
var c: Area3D
var d: RayCast3D
var e: ShapeCast3D
var f: RunState
var g: TiltInput
var h: TubeWindow
var i := randi()
var j := randf()
var k: RandomNumberGenerator


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	randomize()
	Input.get_vector(&"a", &"b", &"c", &"d")
	Engine.get_frames_drawn()
	Time.get_ticks_usec()
	OS.get_name()
	DisplayServer.window_get_size()
	get_tree()
	PhysicsServer3D.area_create()
	hit_reported.emit()
	request_restart()
	get_process_delta_time()
